name: Ginger-Steam Terraces
core_rationale: Tenth terracotta-and-mineral-spring terrace cluster of Hearthbloom Basin where Sola's geothermal vents simmer wild ginger roots and glazed ceramic steam-baths.
local_conflict: Effervescent ginger-steam sprites and glazed-clay bathhouse golems bubble out of the over-pressurized mineral cisterns.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Dense aromatic steam clouds across Cardamom-Cloud Overlook require Bathhouse-Matron Yuzu's Porcelain Whistle Valve.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bathhouse keepers in Ginger-Bathhouse Haven say the northern travertine vents release warm cardamom-scented clouds that lift paper lanterns straight into the sky.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped golden-ochre travertine pools and glazed ceramic steam-chimneys rising toward Cardamom-Cloud Overlook.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which ancient Kiln-Master sealed the master pressure-valve beneath Cardamom-Cloud Overlook?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern geothermal rim of Continent 01 and connects west to Cinnamon-Mill Haven.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stepped golden-ochre travertine pools and whistling ceramic teapot bathhouses veiled in aromatic ginger steam.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m travertine walkways, 0.58m ceramic bath counters, and 0.14m pool step risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with flora and construct monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-cardamom-cloud-overlook in Mystery status behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
